newsitem.title: USA: Two men being questioned in Chicago triple homicide.
newsitem.headline: Two men being questioned in Chicago triple homicide.

text.p: Two men were being questioned Saturday in a triple stabbing murder in Chicago, though no charges had been filed, police said.

The victims, described as white men ages 27, 39 and 40, were found in a southwest-side apartment with their throats slit and one had been stabbed dozens of times, a police spokeswoman said. Their names were not released.
Police said they were questioning two men who were found at the murder scene Saturday morning. The men were not identified because no charges had been filed, the spokeswoman said.
